completion_rule: All required gates pass with captured evidence and independent review. Every conditional extension has an independently reviewed adopt/defer decision; undecided/investigating entries need a disposition. Adopted extensions require nonempty individually tracked passed child gates; reviewed deferrals retain prior history. Parent required:false never waives adopted child gates. Required external validation and distributed core cannot be waived. Authorized repository publication is verified; external submission/communications are separate handoff items.
